Founded in July of 2016, Little Lives Small Animal Rescue is a 501c3 nonprofit organization located in Tri-Cities, Washington that primarily focuses on rescuing small animals such as rodents, reptiles, birds, rabbits and etc. 

We want to help the animals in and around our community as much as possible. Our journey started with a paralyzed bearded dragon, an abandoned pet mouse, and a chinchilla without a home. Since starting our rescue, we have saved several animal types including geckos, guinea pigs, rabbits, bearded dragons, fish, iguanas, snakes, mice, and more.

We have a large number of rescued rabbits with limited rabbit fosters. We try to help the public with rabbit care and advice since overpopulation and dumping is a huge problem in our area. Please neuter/spay your rabbit and litter box train them (using pine pellet cat litter). It will make your life easier!

Enjoy our cute critters and thank you for the support!!

Little Lives Small Animal Rescue
